attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Occupational Therapy Practice

rules.accepted_credit_types: Must relate to or support OT practice and the licensee's current or intended area of practice. Workshops, refresher courses, conferences, seminars by AOTA, NBCOT, NDOTA, medical associations, educational or health organizations, or Board-approved (no limit); professional presentations (no limit, once each); community presentations (max 8); academic courses (1–2 credits = 5 h, 3–4 credits = 10 h); publications (chapter 10, peer-reviewed article 10, other article 5, lay article 2); instructional multimedia (5); research or grant-funded projects (10); and other listed activities.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initially licensed July 1 – December 31 of an odd-numbered year: 10 contact hours; on or after January 1 of an even-numbered year: none until the next licensing period.
rules.audit_note: Copies of CE certificates (or the Board's attendance form signed by a supervisor) are submitted with the renewal application. Waivers for medical hardship or extraordinary circumstances.
rules.notes: Hours must be earned in the 24 months before the completed renewal application is received; each hour counts for one renewal only. Licenses renew biennially in even-numbered years and expire if not renewed by June 30. The rule defines 1 contact hour = 1 clock hour (the Board's older CE page uses a 50-minute hour; 1.0 CEU = 10 contact hours).
rules.rule_quote: 1. The board requires a minimum of twenty contact hours within the twenty-four months prior to the completed application for renewal of licensure.
